description: This file contains mock implementations and utility functions for testing the LLM-based auto-completion system, including creating mock models, context providers, and completion providers, as well as checking model support for Fill-In-Middle (FIM) functionality.

classes.name: StubRecentlyVisitedRangesService
classes.description: Stub class for recently visited ranges service, returns empty snippets.

classes.name: StubRecentlyEditedTracker
classes.description: Stub class for recently edited ranges tracker, returns empty ranges.

methods.name: modelSupportsFim
methods.description: Checks if a model supports Fill-In-Middle based on its ID.

methods.name: createTestGhostModel
methods.description: Creates a mock GhostModel that delegates to an LLMClient, supporting FIM and response generation.

methods.name: createMockContextProvider
methods.description: Creates a mock GhostContextProvider with static snippets and model.

methods.name: createProviderForTesting
methods.description: Creates a GhostInlineCompletionProvider instance with initialized dependencies for testing.
